verdict.rationale: ClickUp's first-party marketing says its in-product AI, Brain², sees your tasks, docs and conversations in real time. It also says Brain² answers complex questions from your workspace and connected apps (Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce) to deliver 'answers and insights', and agents like the Triage Agent prioritize work. All of this is short homepage marketing copy rather than detailed documentation, and there is no hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the insights and suggestions work, evidence of proactive suggestions beyond answering questions on request, independent or hands-on corroboration.
